subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class JSON-RPC child-process plugin ABI to the public plugin SDK and manifest contract, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 as the landing path?
rationale: This is a new public plugin API and security boundary, the issue is maintainer-authored with a protected label, and an open linked PR already contains the candidate implementation.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked PR's manifest ABI, lifecycle, security, and availability contract before merge.

options.title: Narrow before accepting
options.body: Ask for the protocol to be reduced, gated, or kept experimental if maintainers are not ready to freeze the full ABI.

options.title: Reject this direction
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide language-neutral plugin runtimes should remain plugin-owned wrappers outside core SDK.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked PR's manifest ABI, lifecycle, security, and availability contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the issue and linked implementation proposal and has recent plugin SDK history in the affected surface.
